Kalpataru Projects secures ₹2,225 crore in new orders

Kalpataru Projects International Limited (KPIL) has secured new orders totaling ₹2,225 crore. These orders are for its Transmission & Distribution (T&D) business and are spread across both Indian and overseas markets.
